physical_scale.definition: Fixed SI binding for the canonical point-mass experiment, not observed solar ephemerides; GM uses IAU2015 nominal solar mass parameter.

instrument_history.cadence_policy: wall cadence at confirmed worker snapshots; actual physical timestamps retained; no integrator substep or interpolation

orbital_instruments.policy: Ângulos críticos osculantes em plano inercial fixo, com primário explícito. Razão de períodos e arco amostrado não provam ressonância ou captura permanente. Leituras passivas, sem força adicional ou reinício do integrador.

numerical_policy.single_body_policy: INDIVIDUAL error criterion for exactly one active mass with zero force; PRS23 for multiple masses

integration_boundary.policy: pause near point-mass singularity; no collision response or merger

conservation.scope: translational Newtonian centers; kinematic spin/internal energy excluded
